about: Bills paid by someone else, labeled by whether they are a shelter cost (counted as in-kind support). Labels come from the rule text in content/authorities.json: the shelter list in 20 CFR 416.1130(b)(1) and 89 FR 21199 (food omitted from September 30, 2024), SSA's phone-bill example in POMS SI 00815.400B.2, and the household-cost list in POMS SI 00835.465D. Two cases are labeled contested because the two rulebooks differ or the bill mixes both kinds; for those, the right outcome is a route that keeps the check whole under either reading.

cases.description: Northside Electric Co-op. Monthly bill for residential electric service at her apartment.
cases.basis: 20 CFR 416.1130(b)(1) lists electricity.

cases.description: Metro Gas Company. Natural gas service for heating and cooking at her home.
cases.basis: 20 CFR 416.1130(b)(1) lists gas.

cases.description: Lakeside Propane. Delivery of 100 gallons of propane for heating her home.
cases.basis: 20 CFR 416.1130(b)(1) lists heating fuel.

cases.description: City of Brookfield Utilities. Quarterly residential water and sewer service.
cases.basis: 20 CFR 416.1130(b)(1) lists water and sewerage.

cases.description: Valley Waste Services. Curbside garbage pickup at her home, monthly.
cases.basis: 20 CFR 416.1130(b)(1) lists garbage collection services.

cases.description: Maple Court Apartments. December rent for her apartment, unit 4B.
cases.basis: 20 CFR 416.1130(b)(1) lists rent.

cases.description: First Home Mortgage. Monthly mortgage payment on the house she owns.
cases.basis: 20 CFR 416.1130(b)(1) lists mortgage payments.

cases.description: Brookfield County Treasurer. Real property tax installment on her home.
cases.basis: 20 CFR 416.1130(b)(1) lists real property taxes.

cases.description: Horizon Wireless. Monthly cell phone plan in her name.
cases.basis: POMS SI 00815.400B.2: a sister paying the phone bill does not result in income.

cases.description: FastNet. Home internet service, monthly.
cases.basis: Not in the shelter list of 20 CFR 416.1130(b)(1); POMS SI 00835.465D.1 says its list of household costs is the only one used.

cases.description: CableVision. Cable television package, monthly.
cases.basis: Not in the shelter list of 20 CFR 416.1130(b)(1) or POMS SI 00835.020B.36.

cases.description: FreshMart. Weekly groceries delivered to her apartment.
cases.basis: 89 FR 21199: food is no longer counted as in-kind support from September 30, 2024.

cases.description: Northside Physical Therapy. Co-pay for a weekly therapy session.
cases.basis: Not a shelter item; not in 20 CFR 416.1130(b)(1).

cases.description: Riverside Mobility Repair. New push rims and a brake adjustment for her wheelchair.
cases.basis: Not a shelter item; not in 20 CFR 416.1130(b)(1).

cases.description: Eastgate Community College. Spring semester tuition.
cases.basis: Not a shelter item; not in 20 CFR 416.1130(b)(1).

cases.description: SafeDrive Auto Insurance. Six-month premium for her car.
cases.basis: Not a shelter item; POMS SI 00835.465D.3 counts only property insurance required by a mortgage holder.

cases.description: HomeShield. Monthly renters insurance premium for her apartment.
cases.basis: POMS SI 00835.465D.3 counts only property insurance required by a mortgage holder; renters insurance is not.

cases.description: SafeKeep Self Storage. Monthly rent for a storage unit holding her furniture.
cases.basis: POMS SI 00835.020B.36: shelter is living quarters; a storage unit is not.

cases.description: Brookfield Mutual. Homeowners insurance premium on her house, required by her mortgage lender.
cases.basis: POMS SI 00835.020B.36 and SI 00835.465D.3 count property insurance required by a mortgage holder; the shelter list in 20 CFR 416.1130(b)(1) does not include insurance.

cases.description: SuperLink. One bill for residential electric service and home internet together.
cases.basis: Electricity is shelter and internet is not, so a single payment for both is mixed.
